description: This file defines the GetMyOrdersHandler class, which handles retrieving a list of orders for a specific user by implementing the IRequestHandler interface for the GetMyOrders request. It uses a repository to asynchronously fetch order data based on a specification and maps the domain entities to view models for presentation.

classes.name: GetMyOrdersHandler
classes.description: Handler for processing requests to retrieve the current user's orders and mapping them into view models.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the GetMyOrders request by applying a specification to filter orders and projecting them into a collection of OrderViewModels.
